scope: Implement the FIRST HALF of package M1-W1 (web) from docs/architecture/M1_USTAWIENIA_JAKO_GRAF_2026-10-16.md section '### M1-W1' (line 326; read that section and what it points to, nothing else). The kernel side is DONE on this branch (HEAD f9f83a29): read the K1b summary in docs/reports/QUEUE_S1.md section 'K1b GOTOWE' and the K1a one ('K1a GOTOWE'). W1a = THE SHEET 'CO WYSLALISMY': (1) loom/web/src/api/*: calls context.modify (POST /api/context/modify, body {step:'wider'|'narrower'|'deeper'|'shallower'} or {profile:'<selector_profiles id>'} or {reset:true} plus conversation_id; the response is a run document: status completed|awaiting_usage|rejected|failed, text in result.parts[0].text, data in result.data; on awaiting_usage the x10 question is answered with POST /api/actions/confirm {run_id, approved, receipt_id, ref}) and context.receipt (POST /api/context/receipt {msg_id?, conversation_id}; result.data = {msg_id, request_msg_id, receipt} or {missing_reason:'before_m1', also_when:[...]}); the receipt shape loom.context_receipt/1 = order{name,classes}, profile{id,label,source,status,applied{...},unapplied}, profile_prefix, modifiers{profile,breadth_delta,depth_delta,scope}, guard{resource,bytes,baseline,ratio,growth_factor,asked,status,...}, flow, renderer, sections[{class,items[{ref,label,source_kind,why,tokens_est}],tokens_est}], dropped[{ref,reason,count,refs}], tokens_est, sha256, truncated. (2) new loom/web/src/components/ContextReceipt.tsx: the sheet - sections as lists with white-space: pre-wrap, tokens as numbers, cost as an amount or the words 'nieznany - brak ceny', a header with the profile, the modifiers, 'prefiks staly', 'straznik x10', the list 'pominiete' (dropped) with counts and reasons in words, a sentence saying this is the compiled request and not proof of delivery; buttons: 'Pokaz w grafie' (graph.navigate focus=msg, perspectives=[sent_to_model]; if the kernel still answers Unsupported for the receipt source, keep the button VISIBLE and disabled with the reason in words, and say so in your card - do NOT implement kernel code in this package), 'Nastepnym razem' szerzej/glebiej/wezej/plycej (context.modify, turn only; handle awaiting_usage by showing the kernel's question and calling actions.confirm), 'Zmien profil' (list from the selector_profiles of the effective view / the data, with their labels and the status calibration|preset|legacy shown), and for old messages the words 'brak sladu (zapisane przed M1)'. All labels in plain Polish (and English) from DATA (the conversation_view.pack presentation block - follow how other screens do it, no literals in the component; add the keys to the pack and regenerate the embedded/generated files exactly as the neighbours do). (3) loom/web/src/components/ChatView.tsx: under an answer the line 'Kontekst: ... - zobacz' (per receipt_link of the pack; opens the sheet), a menu entry '... > Co wyslalismy', and REMOVE the <pre> JSON of the trace from CHAT mode (it stays in the expert mode; nothing is deleted from the expert mode). (4) Tests: unit tests for the pure state/format functions (put them next to the neighbours, add the npm script to package.json and the CI step list in .github/workflows/loom.yml next to the other test:* lines); the e2e loom/web/e2e/m1-context-sent-native.mjs (390x844, touch, the real loom-server with web/e2e/mock_llm_server.py as the model: two messages, the second sent after tapping 'Szerzej' -> the number of items of the section Graf grows for that request and is back to the base for the next one; profile 'Zgodnosc' -> only the sections Instrukcja and Rozmowa) - follow the patterns of e2e/m1-navigator-native.mjs and m1-settings-native.mjs (helpers, shots dir via M1_SHOTS_DIR or the temp default, no hard-coded literal of a label: take it from the pack), add its testids to docs/reports/M1_W0_TESTIDS.md the way test:testids-doc wants, add an npm script test:m1-context-sent and a CI step next to test:m1-settings. TIMING RULE: never read an attribute or text right after a tap if the UI sets it from an effect - wait for it (three CI failures today came from that); no sleeps that race. NOT W1a (leave for W1b and say so): the composer '+' menu submenu context (wider/deeper/narrower/shallower chips, selector_profile list, flow_text_graph, preview_request), the ContextStrip, the model chip with provenance (model-provenance), retrieval-plan.ts / ContextSlider.tsx. Commit in coherent pieces (api -> pack words+generated -> sheet component -> ChatView -> unit tests -> e2e+CI) and push to origin claude/m1-w0. If after about 60 tool calls a piece is unfinished, commit what is consistent and return done=false with exactly what is left.
accept: cd loom/web && npm run build succeeds; the new unit test script and all existing test:* scripts the CI lists for the web pass (at least: test:shell-menu, test:composer-menu, test:navigator-state, test:node-card-state, test:settings-human, test:role-card, test:testids-doc, test:chat-first, and the neighbours of what you touched in ChatView); node e2e/m1-context-sent-native.mjs passes TWICE in a row and leaves git status clean (no changed tracked fixtures or screenshots); node e2e/m1-navigator-native.mjs and e2e/m1-settings-native.mjs still pass; every commit pushed to origin claude/m1-w0; the card lists files, decisions with how to reverse them, what the sheet shows for a real receipt (paste the rendered text of one section from the e2e), what is disabled and why, and what is left for W1b.
rules_extra: Shared machine: never kill processes by name; record the pid you started (e2e servers on your own port). Do NOT run the full gate (S1 does). CACHE RULE: no single tool call longer than ~4 minutes - run long builds/tests in the background and poll with short calls. Keep context small: grep and line ranges, never dump big files. Texts for the owner in plain Polish and English; nothing described as working that is only planned. Everything configurable, defaults are presets, nothing hidden silently.
